title: Chapter 1438 - 13: A Dim And Dark Future
content:
Chapter 1438 - 13: A Dim And Dark Future

Chapter 1438 - 13: A Dim and Dark Future

Wanwei Space-Time.

The timeline behind Lin Yuan returned to stability.

"Those white jade steps..." Lin Yuan fell into a moment of contemplation.

The future self he summoned was positioned on an endless staircase of white jade.

And this white jade staircase, the grand crimson figure from the future time-space clearly recognized it and gave responses like 'critical future scene' and 'not necessary at all'.

It was evident that the white jade steps were quite renowned in the future; otherwise, a Legendary Lord wouldn't exhibit such an attitude.

"In the future timeline I observed, there were no white jade steps, and most of the scenes were blurred, distorted, even pitch-black..."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

When he first entered the life of time, observing future timelines was always favorable.

But as his strength increased and realm elevated, the usefulness of future timelines decreased.

Because many scenes and bits of information involved transcendence, or were related to the awareness of the Supreme Rule Dao, they wouldn't show up on the timeline at all, and could only be experienced firsthand.

This situation was especially evident among the Legendary Lords.

The Legendary Lords must have delved into the two transcendent paths of 'Infinite Origin' and 'Endless Tribulation'.

Their future could unexpectedly turn dark at any time due to these two transcendent paths.

The more one explores the ancient timelines of the 'Infinite Origin' path, the more unforeseen events are likely to occur, with a greater chance of getting lost or perishing in the past.

The 'Endless Tribulation' is even more so, with the final phase consisting of three hundred thirty million tribulations, each being a walk on the edge of life and death, and the slightest misstep would lead to soul and body destruction.

"At least this summoning let me know that in the future, 'I' should be doing quite well."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face.

He did not know that the Blood Sea Lord's past, present, and future had been completely erased.

But from the scenes just now, the future self of the Blood Sea Lord showed no resistance against his own future self.

This indicated that his future strength should be incredibly terrifying.

And this was just the future self Lin Yuan summoned several million years down the line.

"Blood Sea Lord."

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts and looked at the three floating corpses in the distance.

No matter how powerful his future self might be, for now, Lin Yuan was not even a Lord yet, having just recently escaped from 'poverty'.

The three Lords' corpses represented a tremendous fortune to him, and it was natural to collect them immediately.

Swoosh.

The three corpses, including that of the Blood Sea Lord, were absorbed into Lin Yuan's internal universe.

At the same time, Lin Yuan began to inspect them immediately.

"Five Lord-level weapons."

Lin Yuan discovered five weapons hidden inside the three corpses.

Among them was a weapon belonging to the Tianshi Lord, along with the flesh of the Tianshi Lord.

Of the five Lord-level weapons, the most valuable was the 'Dark Ocean', which belonged to a legendary tier.

'Dark Ocean' was a suppressive type of weapon with a disguise function; the Blood Sea Lord used it to set traps in Wanwei Space-Time, disguising as a treasure-fortune ground, relying on 'Dark Ocean'.

"This is a huge gain."

A smile reappeared on Lin Yuan's face.

The five Lord-level weapons, excluding 'Dark Ocean', each have a value not less than eighty million jin of Time Sand.

Ordinary Lord-level weapons range from hundreds of thousands to several million jin of Time Sand, but the Blood Sea Lord, as a second-tier peak Lord, and the Tianshi Lord, being of the same tier, with the Void Spirit Lord and Lord of Armor being slightly weaker but not by much, heavily invested in their Lord weapons, far surpassing typical Lord-level weapons.

As for 'Dark Ocean'? Being a legendary-tier Lord weapon, its estimated value is two hundred million jin of Time Sand.

In other words, the five Lord-level weapons have a total value equivalent to five hundred and twenty million jin of Time Sand.

Additionally, there are scattered treasures and rare items, amounting to a value of about one or two million jin of Time Sand.

It's important to know, despite many encounters in Wanwei Space-Time, all of Lin Yuan's previous acquisitions only amounted to treasures worth thirty to forty million jin of Time Sand.

But now?

Directly over five hundred million jin of Time Sand in gains?

"What a pity..."

Lin Yuan couldn't help but feel regretful.

The trap set by the Blood Sea Lord and the other three Lords certainly ensnared other Time Lords before the Tianshi Lord.

These Time Lords likely chose to use Time Sand to ensure the survival of their bodies, but that Time Sand? Surely traded outside Wanwei Space-Time.

Within Wanwei Space-Time, no Time Lords could carry such a large amount of Time Sand.

Even Lin Yuan's acquisition of the five Lord-level weapons was an unexpected variable; normally, Lords entering Wanwei Space-Time wouldn't bring excessively valuable weapons.

However, the Blood Sea Lord and the other three Lords went against the norm, bringing four weapons under the guise of having future selves who already crossed into the legendary tier as backup, including a Lord weapon at the legendary level.

The Tianshi Lord had a 'try and see' attitude, believing that without the intervention of Legendary Lords, other Lords couldn't pose a true threat.

...

"These three corpses, plus the Tianshi Lord's body, are also invaluable."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, considering how much effort and cost would be involved in forging a main combat body.

The simplest use would be to return these four bodies back to their Origin Source, refining them back into origin power or directly forging them into five Lord-level weapons.

As for other uses... the best option would naturally be to sell them back to their original owners.
